message.content: {"summary": "The proposed revisions address critical race conditions in image loading, accessibility failures in focus management, and timing drift in the rotation logic.", "verdict": "ACCEPT", "items": [{"issue": "Cached images bypass onLoad, potentially hanging the transition state in ArtBackdrop.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtScene.tsx: { setLoaded(true); onReady?.() }} />", "change": "Add a useEffect in ArtScene to check image.current.complete on mount and trigger onReady() if true.", "check": "Test rapid navigation between previously viewed artworks to ensure immediate transition."}, {"issue": "Focus management in ArtViewer is suboptimal; autoFocus on the Close button skips the primary content.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtViewer.tsx: ", "change": "Remove autoFocus from the Close button; set initial focus to the dialog or the first control.", "check": "Verify tab order and screen reader entry point upon opening the viewer."}, {"issue": "The rotation timer in ArtViewer uses an accumulator in a setInterval that resets frequently due to dependency changes.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtViewer.tsx: setInterval(() => { ... }, 250) depends on [playing, paused, visible, failed, loaded, selected.id]", "change": "Refactor to use a timestamp-based delta calculation to prevent timing drift during state updates.", "check": "Verify 60-second rotation accuracy when toggling 'Pause motion' or switching tabs."}]}
